title: The test runner leaves test tokens outside its temp folder
what: tests/run_unittest.py takes its test-token pool from a temp folder (or the gate's pool when a gate passes one) and leaves nothing outside it.
why: Found 30 Oct while measuring tests on the VPS ai.amidman.com: run on a machine without relay, tests/run_unittest.py created $RELAY_HOME/test-tokens (default ~/.relay, there /root/.relay) and left it behind. Project rule: tests use a temporary folder and never touch live state.
failing_case: 30 Oct on the VPS: after `python3 tests/run_unittest.py <files>` from a temp copy of lib/, tests/, bin/, `/root/.relay/test-tokens` existed (removed by hand).
pass_cases: A test runs the runner with HOME and RELAY_HOME unset or pointing at an empty temp dir and finds no new folder outside its temp dir afterwards.
Under relay gate, the runner still shares the gate's token pool.
